advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer SCLSU Mud Dogs: DeVonta Smith for Jaylen Warren.

reasons: You're 8-2 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 18%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 3rd of 10 contenders (154.0 points a week).
Your weakest position is TE (5th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 2nd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 3rd in 2028 (title chances about 18%, 16%, 18%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 18% to 20%, and your lineup comes out 0.8 points a week ahead overall. DeVonta Smith adds 2.7 points a week for you today, but Jaylen Warren is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 2,784, get 2,812), and it barely changes their lineup (+0.2 a week).
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 16% and 18% to 18% and 18%.
You have 3 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Week 14 is your weakest projected week (161 points vs your usual 176), mostly byes.
Rhamondre Stevenson may be worth more now than later: age 28: RB values usually drop after this season.
Jayden Daniels's trade value has dropped 16% in 30 days.
Tee Higgins's trade value has dropped 16% in 30 days.
Isaiah Likely's trade value has dropped 17% in 30 days.
advice.key: ["trade", "Make a trade", ["Offer SCLSU Mud Dogs: DeVonta Smith for Jaylen Warren."]]
